# BadgeBox

> Create, award, and manage decentralized badges on the Nostr network using the NIP-58 specification.

BadgeBox is a web application for decentralized badge/credential management. All badge data lives on Nostr relays — no centralized database required. Badges are cryptographically signed, verifiable, and censorship-resistant.

## Quick Facts

- Web App: https://badgebox.rinbal.de
- Documentation: https://docs-badgebox.netlify.app
- Protocol: Nostr (NIP-58 Badges)
- License: MIT
- Stack: FastAPI (Python) backend + Vue.js 3 frontend

## What It Does

- Create custom badges with name, description, and image
- Award badges to any Nostr user by public key (npub or hex)
- Receive badges and choose which to display on your profile
- Request badges from issuers with supporting proof
- Browse and discover badges across the Nostr network
- View badge profiles for any Nostr user

## Nostr Event Kinds Used

- Kind 30009: Badge Definition (name, image, description)
- Kind 8: Badge Award (issuer awards badge to recipients)
- Kind 30008: Profile Badges (user's accepted/displayed badges)
- Kind 30058: Badge Request (user requests a badge from issuer)
- Kind 30059: Badge Denial (issuer denies a request)
- Kind 5: Deletion (NIP-09, for withdrawing requests or revoking denials)

## API Base URL

Local: http://localhost:8000
Production: https://badgebox.rinbal.de (backend proxied)

## Key API Endpoints

POST /api/v1/auth/validate — Validate nsec key
POST /api/v1/badges/create-definition — Create badge (kind 30009)
POST /api/v1/badges/award — Award badge to recipients (kind 8)
POST /api/v1/badges/create-and-award — Atomic create + award
GET  /api/v1/inbox/pending — Get unaccepted badges
GET  /api/v1/inbox/accepted — Get accepted badges
POST /api/v1/inbox/accept — Accept a badge (kind 30008)
GET  /api/v1/profile/{pubkey} — Get user profile metadata
GET  /api/v1/profile/{pubkey}/badges — Get user's displayed badges
GET  /api/v1/surf/recent — Browse recently created badges
GET  /api/v1/surf/search — Search badges by name/description
POST /api/v1/requests/create — Request a badge (kind 30058)
GET  /api/v1/requests/incoming — Get requests for your badges
GET  /api/v1/requests/outgoing — Get requests you sent

## Authentication

Two header-based methods:
- X-Nsec: Pass nsec key directly (backend signs events)
- X-Pubkey: Pass hex pubkey for read ops; include signed_event in body for writes (NIP-07 browser extension flow)

## Use Cases

- Community recognition and reputation
- Event attendance proof (POAPs)
- Course completion certificates
- Professional certifications
- Membership and access control
- Achievement/gamification systems
- Open source contributor recognition
- Privacy-preserving identity verification

## Integration Pattern

To check if a user holds a badge:
1. Query kind 30008 events for the user's pubkey with d=profile_badges
2. Check if the badge's a-tag (30009:<issuer>:<identifier>) is in the tags
3. Verify the issuer pubkey is the expected authority

## Configured Relays

wss://relay.damus.io, wss://nos.lol, wss://offchain.pub, wss://relay.snort.social, wss://relay.primal.net, wss://relay.0xchat.com, wss://relay.azzamo.net, wss://shu05.shugur.net, wss://cache1.primal.net
